correctness.rationale: The exact driftless quadratic Gaussian transform has mean and Green covariance as displayed in RESULT, including right Neumann and left Dirichlet boundaries. The fixed-parameter hard-budget Bromwich integral localizes at u=1/(8 theta^2) with curvature 4 theta^3; mixed early/late Gaussian covariances vanish, the terminal tilt shifts mean by mu C_late(r,0), and terminal fourth increments are bounded by C|r-s|^2 via contour integration. This proves path-level tightness and joint convergence; initial tightness is supplied by the actual primary theorem. A standalone code run gave 569 finite checks. Residual risk: independent proof scrutiny of uniform complex contour estimates is outstanding.
